headings.usage: Use for numeric data, day titles, main headers. Always apply tracking-tight or tracking-tighter.

body.usage: Use for exercise names, labels, secondary text.

spacing_and_layout.container: w-full max-w-md mx-auto px-6 pb-24 pt-8 min-h-screen
spacing_and_layout.tap_targets: Minimum 48px height/width for all interactive elements.
spacing_and_layout.gap: gap-4 to gap-6 between major sections.

motion.page_transition: Fade in with subtle upward slide (y: 10 to 0).
motion.tap_feedback: Scale down to 0.97 on active/tap. Use framer-motion whileTap={{ scale: 0.97 }}.

ProfileTile.style: bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded-2xl p-6 flex items-center justify-between hover:bg-slate-800 transition-colors

PinPad.style: grid grid-cols-3 gap-6 max-w-xs mx-auto mt-12
PinPad.button_style: w-20 h-20 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-3xl font-headings text-white bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 active:bg-slate-800

DayTile.style: bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded-2xl p-5 mb-4 flex flex-col gap-2 relative overflow-hidden
DayTile.title: text-3xl font-headings text-white uppercase tracking-tight
DayTile.subtitle: text-sm font-body text-slate-400

StatusBadge.style: px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-body uppercase tracking-wider font-semibold border

ExerciseCard.style: bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-5 mb-3
ExerciseCard.title: text-lg font-body text-white font-medium

CircuitCard.style: bg-slate-900 border border-indigo-900/50 rounded-xl p-1 mb-3
CircuitCard.header: text-indigo-400 text-sm font-headings uppercase tracking-widest mb-3

icons.usage: Use subtle icons (strokeWidth 1.5). Key icons: User, Lock, CheckCircle2, Circle, XCircle, Plus, ChevronLeft, Dumbbell.

accessibility_and_testing.test_ids: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='profile-select-button').
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Text contrast passes APCA/WCAG standards on dark backgrounds.

instructions_to_main_agent: Initialize React PWA configuration (manifest.json, service worker).
Setup Tailwind config with Slate colors and Barlow Condensed + DM Sans fonts.
Implement LocalStorage/IndexedDB state management for profiles and weekly progress.
Week progress resets dynamically based on current real-world Monday.
Build views: Profile Selection, Add Profile, PIN Pad, Week Dashboard, Day Details (placeholder list).
Use framer-motion for smooth transition between PIN Pad and Dashboard.
Ensure touch targets are 48px+ for mobile usage.
DO NOT implement backend logic; pure offline execution.
